#### 1. parietal foramina 2  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.784)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:450)

**Proposed mechanism:** ALX4 (HGNC:450) —DISRUPTS→ Craniofacial development regulation (GO:0001958); Craniofacial development regulation (GO:0001958) —LEADS_TO→ Frontonasal dysplasia (HP:0000267); Craniofacial development regulation (GO:0001958) —LEADS_TO→ Parietal foramina (HP:0000253). **How to falsify it:** The presence of pathogenic variants in ALX4 with a consistent loss-of-function effect (e.g., nonsense mutations, frameshifts) in individuals with both MONDO:0013268 and MONDO:0012309 would support this hypothesis. **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of ALX4 in these conditions could lead to the identification of common therapeutic targets or strategies for managing craniofacial development defects in both diseases.
